name: Regsvcs.exe
description: Regsvcs and Regasm are Windows command-line utilities that are used to register .NET Component Object Model (COM) assemblies
author: Oddvar Moe

commands.description: Loads the target .NET DLL file and executes the RegisterClass function.
commands.usecase: Execute dll file and bypass Application whitelisting
commands.os: Windows vista, Windows 7, Windows 8, Windows 8.1, Windows 10, Windows 11
